title: Maha govt's proposal to bring private universities under FRA sparks debate
description:
Maharashtra's proposal to bring self-financed private universities and autonomous colleges under Fee Regulatory Authority (FRA) has triggered a debate, with ministers and political leaders expressing divergent views.
The FRA regulates fees charged by private unaided professional educational institutions, including those offering medical, engineering, pharmacy and management courses.
The proposal was shared by Higher and Technical Education Minister Chandrakant Patil, who told a regional news channel that the government was examining the fee structures, financial balances, land allotments and other details of self-financed universities. These institutions would be required to submit affidavits disclosing information about their functioning, he said.
Patil questioned whether such universities were currently covered under FRA and how they had acquired land for their campuses, citing examples of educational institutions in Kolhapur and Pune.
